title: הברק שחם פי חמישה מהשמש — ומשאיר זכוכית בתוך האדמה
summary: Lightning heats air to ~30,000 °C (NWS 50,000 °F ≈ 27,760 °C, ~5× the Sun's 5,500 °C surface) through electrical resistance in a cm-wide channel; the explosive expansion is thunder; light vs sound (343 m/s, seconds ÷ 3 = km) and lightning safety; fulgurites — quartz melts ~1,700 °C, hot gas leaves a hollow core, fast cooling makes glass; Darwin at Maldonado, the 1996 Florida 5.2 m record, Franklin 1752, Lake Maracaibo, Hess 2021 phosphorus; Israel's winter lightning max over Mount Carmel; division, distance = speed × time, time = distance ÷ speed, °F→°C and ratio challenge.
reviewer_verdict: PASS (3 rounds) — nits left: est. ~28–32 min per track vs the 'כ־25 דקות' tag; thunder readout label wraps at 390px; kit lint/check missing from the repo so local stand-ins were used; Arto and the AI grader not exercised offline; review copy doesn't declare the sample capability (template)
